The PC website card list<ref name="cl-1261_69">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142254/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2013-01-11]; the same text in the VMasterType list) (Internet Archive)</ref> shows the same card with the card list's usual notation (icons written out or dropped, quotes as single quotes); that is not a version (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).
